title: Pāṭala External-Tool Manifest
description: Machine-readable registry of the mature open infrastructure Pāṭala borrows (reuse-first doctrine). Validates source-evidence/docs/tools/MANIFEST.json. Each entry names what Pāṭala borrows, the license, docs, repository, INTEGRATION STATUS, and where in the code it is actually used.

status.description: INTEGRATED = in production code path, tested. WIRED = a working adapter exists. PARTIAL = partially wired / a stub. DOCS_ONLY = documented, no code. PLANNED = identified, not started. WATCH = audited as prior-art, not adopted. NOT_USED = documented but intentionally not used.

used_in.description: Concrete code paths (file:line or module) where this tool is used. Empty = not wired.
